title: Claude-Mem brings persistent, searchable context to coding agents
friendlyTitle: Claude-Mem helps coding agents remember work between sessions
summary: Claude-Mem is an Apache-2.0 project that captures agent activity, compresses it and retrieves relevant context in later sessions across tools including Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Hermes and Copilot. It leads today’s AI-related trending candidates with about 95,500 stars and 8,500 forks.
friendlySummary: This popular open-source project saves and searches useful context for many coding agents. It has about 95,500 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Developers can use it to reduce repeated explanations and make long-running coding work easier to resume. Because persistent memory can retain sensitive prompts, code and mistakes, review its storage, retention and retrieval behaviour before connecting important repositories.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when you are tired of explaining the same project again. Check what it stores and protect private code before turning it on.
